fieldValues.title: Re-rendering catches drift between page and record, but not forgery
fieldValues.summary: A reader that re-renders the composition from the payload detects a record edited after printing even when the archive checksum is rewritten, but a forger who also rewrites the rendered-text checksum passes; only a signature over the PDF closes that.
evidence: Tamper tests 2026-11-27: swapped payload fails archive and render checks; swapped payload with rewritten archive checksum fails the render check
fieldValues.body: The binding is for honest drift (someone edits the record or the page), which is the common case. Authorship needs a signature, and a PDF signature covers the attachment.
